_readme: Copy to alerts.json (git-ignored) and fill in ONE OR BOTH. Without alerts.json, alerts only go to logs/uptime-watch.log and a Windows notification on this machine.
webhookUrl: https://hooks.slack.com/services/... or a Discord webhook URL (posted as JSON with text/content/title/message)
emailFrom: optional: defaults to the service's EMAIL_FROM
resendApiKey: optional: defaults to the service's RESEND_API_KEY
